title: Say Sorry!
description: A mod which requires players to apologize after doing team kills
body:
# Say Sorry!

This is a mod that requires players to apologize after killing others. I found the inspiration for this from the tactical game *Squad*.

## Features

After you accidentally kill another player, the mod will require you to apologize by typing "sorry". If you fail to do so, you will be kicked from the game within five minutes!

![Screenshots of the mod content](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a779b45ec8a721c87b21ce694227a0e83c186976.png)

## Future Plans

The current version now features friendly/enemy identification.

I will migrate the mod to newer game versions with each major update, but do not plan to backport it.
